summary.title: Added Derrick Jones Jr., dropped Naji Marshall
summary.headline: Done and verified on Yahoo 08:55 ET: +Derrick Jones Jr. (LAC), -Naji Marshall (DAL). Neither plays Monday.
summary.verdict: Our stream tool rates Jones above Marshall for the rest of the season under both projection sets. Small gain; 1 of 6 adds used.
risks: ΔP(title) leans negative under the blend projections (-0.75 ± 0.44 pp, within noise).
When VanVleet (O, in IL) returns, another drop is needed.
No waiver-priority cost (Jones was a free agent).
rationale: - inseason stream (4000 week sims, paired season sims): Jones-for-Marshall is the only pair beating 2 SE on season odds under blend and market.
- Marshall is my lowest-value player now that week 4's extra games are over.
- Rival check agrees: Cam Spencer-for-Marshall would have added +1.0..1.3 ± 0.4 pp P(playoffs).

why_now.before: Sat 11-14: Marshall added into VanVleet's IL spot for week 4's last 2 games (+20 pp P(win wk4)); plan was to drop him when VanVleet returns.

changed.text: Week 4 is over (won 6-3), so Marshall's short-term value is gone.
Today's stream run (ros-proj as_of 11-16) ranks Jones above Marshall beyond noise; it had no such pair on 11-15.
